items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bill Hughes was in the marching band with us too.

ctx.x: No. There was a band at Howard University called the Swing Masters, not officially a part of the university, but Bill Hughes talks about it. Benny talks about it.
That could have been, because Bill Hughes was in the marching band with us too. So that’s why . . .
